axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.title: Capital Markets Lawyer
axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: We are currently seeking Capital Markets Lawyers to work with Axiom clients across financial institutions, investment banks and other organisations. Responsibilities: Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice on a range of capital markets matters, including debt, equity and equity-linked transactions, securities offerings, financings and listed-company matters. Draft, review and negotiate capital-markets documentation, including offering documents, prospectuses, underwriting agreements, purchase agreements, engagement letters, disclosure materials and related transaction documents. Support transactions throughout their lifecycle, including structuring, due diligence, disclosure, documentation, execution, closing and post-transaction requirements. Work closely with legal teams, bankers, issuers, finance, compliance, business stakeholders and external counsel to manage risk and deliver transactions efficiently. Minimum Qualifications: Qualified lawyer eligible to practise in the UK, or an equivalent overseas qualification with relevant UK capital-markets experience, and right to work in the UK. Experience advising on one or more capital markets areas, including debt capital markets, equity capital markets, equity-linked products, securities offerings, listed-company matters or corporate finance. Experience gained in private practice, in-house, on secondment or within an investment bank, financial institution, broker-dealer, issuer or other relevant financial-services environment. Strong commercial awareness, drafting, negotiation, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, pragmatic and business-focused advice in a fast-paced transactional environment. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiom provides the opportunity to work remotely, onsite or hybrid, depending on client requirements. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about working at Axiom . Equal Opportunity Employer: Axiom ensures equal employment opportunity in recruitment and employment, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, nationality, national or ethnic origin, religious creed or belief, political opinion, sex, gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, age, disability, alienage or citizenship status, marital (or civil or other partnership recognized by law) status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, sexual orientation, military service, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Axiom prohibits and will not tolerate any such discrimination or harassment. We understand that many legal professionals have chosen to adopt the consultancy model, and we are happy to discuss this option with you. We offer both consultants and employees the opportunity to work with our enviable client roster. Contact us in complete confidence to find out more about opportunities to work with Axiom as an employee or consultant. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:21.description: Crest Industries believes that when we have the right people in the right seats, we can achieve unlimited success. Our Transfer Portal is designed to empower our team members to learn, grow and build their careers throughout our family of companies. This form is for any employee in the Crest Family of Companies to apply for open positions at Crest Properties. Upload your resume and information into the portal, and select the department you are interested in joining. The Avant talent team will contact you and help you through the rest of the process. If you have any questions or issues with the portal please contact talent@crestoperations.com or your talent manager. Find their information at www.crestoperations.com/careers-contact.

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:b5.title: Packaging Technician
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:b5.description: Come join our collaborative and innovative team at DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations! DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations has been an industry leader in the design and supply of high-voltage, open-air substations, and switchyards since 1965. Over a half-century of building meaningful relationships with our customers and vendors boils down to one thing: people. We take pride in our collaborative approach where everything we do is designed to deliver the project the right way, your way. Though we have grown over the years, and now offer new innovations like our Factory-Built Substations, our age-old commitment will never change: to take care of you like family. DIS-TRAN Packaged Substations is looking to hire a Packaging Technician to work from our Port of Alexandria Facility in our Woodshop Department. A Packaging Technician, as part of a team, helps to package finished products. They also work to build custom cribbing and crating for DTPS. This individual must be able to perform duties with speed and accuracy to produce a quality product and keep a steady flow of products.
responsibilities: Successfully apply simple hand tools such as wrenches, hammer, screwdriver etc.
Operates safety equipment and uses safe work habits.
Build custom cribbing and crating for product.
Packaging of finished products from Welding Department.
Recognizes, sets up, and operates hand and common power tools.
Moves parts safely into position, manually or with hoists or cranes.

Keeps the warehouse property in order, including but not limited to routine maintenance and grooming of grounds and facilities and regular and preventative maintenance on all Company equipment and machinery.
Attends safety meetings as requested / instructed.
Operates all machinery and equipment, including the Company’s forklift, in a safe manner always.
Promotes company goals.
Works to displays an excellent safety record.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2aff1505-203a-.title: Team Lead Product Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2aff1505-203a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in Saudi Arabia. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. Strong ownership mindset, independence, and the ability to take analytical projects from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement. Genuine interes

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7850bbd4-bd4b-.title: Designer - Kids Sleepwear
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7850bbd4-bd4b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Designer – Kids Sleepwear based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to shape distinctive kids’ sleepwear collections within a highly creative, collaborative product design environment. You’ll transform trends, materials, and consumer insights into original product concepts that balance style, quality, functionality, and value. Working closely with merchandising, sourcing, technical design, and engineering partners, you’ll guide designs from concept through development. You’ll own your design process and calendar while ensuring work stays aligned with brand direction, assortment strategies, and commercial objectives. The position combines creative exploration with hands-on execution through sketches, CAD artwork, materials, fabrics, and presentation boards. You’ll also contribute to product problem-solving and brand consistency across a broader portfolio of owned-brand products. This is an on-site role based at a downtown Minneapolis campus, four days per week, with opportunities to leverage AI tools to enhance creative workflows. Develop and support original kids’ sleepwear concepts aligned with creative direction, brand strategy, merchant objectives, assortment plans, and target price points. Conduct trend, material, and technique research to inform innovative and commercially relevant product concepts. Manage assigned design processes and calendars, ensuring projects progress efficiently and deadlines are consistently met. Translate creative ideas into CAD and hand sketches, including silhouettes, form language, illustrations, and detailed product artwork. Prepare professional presentation materials incorporating illustrations, CAD artwork, fabrication details, and material samples. Support product development from initial concept through material selection, refinement, and final execution. Partner closely with merchandising, sourcing, technical design, and engineering teams to address product requirements and resolve development issues. Incorporate feedback from internal and external partners while maintaining the overall creative vision and design intent. Collaborate with design peers to strengthen brand cohesion, continuity, and consistency across product categories. Maintain clear, timely communication with cross-functional and external partners throughout the product development process. Explore and leverage AI-powered creative tools to streamline workflows, accelerate ideation, and improve design outcomes. Requirements: Four-year degree in Design, Fine Art, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of relevant design experience , ideally within retail, apparel, product development, or a comparable environment. Strong proficiency with design software including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop . Experience with CAD illustration and/or 2D/3D design software . Knowledge of textiles, garment construction, fit, raw materials, and product production processes. Demonstrated ability to translate creative concepts into commercially viable and cost-effective design solutions. Experience incorporating product feedback and adapting designs based on business, technical, and customer considerations. Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative, technical, merchandising, and sourcing teams. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Ability to balance creative innovation with commercial objectives, quality expectations, and target price points. Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, New Arc, or Vizcom to enhance creative processes and outcomes. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9d875502-762d-.title: Operations Associate (CX)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:9d875502-762d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Operations Associate (CX) based in Switzerland. This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, operations, and analytical problem-solving within a globally distributed environment. You’ll help clients navigate complex operational questions, from invoice investigations to platform-related issues. The position offers the opportunity to take ownership of client cases from initial inquiry through resolution while collaborating with Finance, Product, and HR Operations teams. You’ll use data and analytical thinking to identify patterns, uncover process gaps, and recommend meaningful improvements. Clear communication and empathy will be essential as you guide clients and internal teams through practical solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complexity and making a measurable impact on customer success. Investigate and resolve invoice-related queries accurately, ensuring clients receive clear explanations and timely solutions. Own client inquiries from initial investigation through final resolution, coordinating with Finance, Product, HR Operations, and other relevant teams as needed. Analyse client queries, recurring issues, and operational trends to identify process gaps and recommend data-driven improvements. Troubleshoot platform-related issues and guide clients and talent through practical solutions to restore functionality efficiently. Create, maintain, and improve knowledge documentation that helps clients and internal teams understand processes and resolve common issues. Manage multiple client cases simultaneously, prioritising workloads effectively while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, empathy, and responsiveness. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that streamline operations and strengthen the overall customer experience. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in customer experience operations, financial support, SaaS, or a similar client-facing operational environment. Strong numerical and analytical abilities, with confidence investigating invoices, working with data, and identifying discrepancies or patterns. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to break down complex information into clear, actionable guidance. A strong ownership mindset, with the ability to proactively manage cases and follow issues through to resolution. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively with clients and internal stakeholders. Highly organised, adaptable, and calm under pressure, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience with invoice management, CRM, or ticketing platforms such as Salesforce or NetSuite is an advantage. Familiarity with EOR, payroll, HR, or workforce management systems is a plus. Additional language skills, particularly German, are beneficial. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries and time zones. Benefits Fully remote working environment with flexibility within approximately ±2 hours of CET. Well-being Day providing dedicated time away from work to recharge. Subsidised gym membership and support for maintaining an active lifestyle. Training and development allowance to support continuous learning and professional growth. Opportunities to participate in annual global team meetups. Inclusive, international working environment with colleagues across multiple countries. Benefits may vary depending on location and applicable local regulations. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Customer Sales Advisor
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! Location: Speeders Car Wash 1603 Main Street, Willimantic, CT 06226
